github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Describe the staged changes, not unrelated changes. Use `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`, with a scope only when it accurately identifies the affected component. Follow the applicable repository commitlint rules. Write the subject in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100), start it with an imperative verb and do not end it with a period. Use short and direct words, keep only necessary articles, and use lowercase prose but keep the exact case of technical names and identifiers. Use `!` before the colon for a breaking change. Do not add a body, footer, attribution, or trailer, such as `Co-authored-by`.
